description: This file defines an interface JmsExceptionThrowingFunction for handling JMS messages with potential exceptions, including a static method to wrap such functions and convert checked JMSExceptions into runtime exceptions.

classes.name: JmsExceptionThrowingFunction
classes.description: A functional interface similar to Function that processes JMS messages and may throw JMSException.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs the operation on the given JMS message, returning a result or throwing JMSException.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Converts a JmsExceptionThrowingFunction into a standard Function by wrapping JMSException into JMSRuntimeException.
